WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.016862 30.682417)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Sikorsky HH-52A Seaguard'
    AND addr_city = 'Mobile'
    AND addr_state = 'AL'
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Azimuth(
      ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), 4326),
      ST_AsPoint(ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Aspect(public.dem_us.rast)).geom)
    ) AS bearing_degrees
  FROM
    poi_geom p,
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
    AND ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Aspect(public.dem_us.rast)).val > 0
)
SELECT
  degrees(bearing_degrees) AS compass_bearing_degrees
FROM
  aspect_raster
ORDER BY
  compass_bearing_degrees
LIMIT 1;
